title: Analyzing Diversity in Healthcare LLM Research: A Scientometric Perspective

bias_targets.methodology: Inferring author genders using the Genderize.io API based on author names and affiliations, and calculating the proportions of male and female authors across overall, first, and last author positions.
Analyzing the geographic distribution of research publications and funding sources by mapping author affiliations and funding organizations to specific countries and continents.

Classifying author affiliations and funding sources into High-Income Countries (HICs) and Low- and Middle-Income Countries (LMICs) using World Bank criteria to measure representation and funding disparities.
